notes: The tutorial gives two alternative circuits (potentiometer OR photoresistor + 10k resistor). Both use A0, so only the potentiometer circuit is built here. The photoresistor variant would replace pot1 with a photoresistor from 5V to A0 plus a 10k resistor from A0 to GND.

In the potentiometer image the yellow wire ends in the top half of the breadboard just above the pot. I assumed it is meant to reach the pot's middle pin, as the text says, so I put it in the same strip as the middle leg (11b.d).
Pot outer pins: GND to the black wire and VCC (5V) to the red wire, as in the image. The two outer pins are interchangeable.

The optional external LED circuit (pin 13 -> 220 ohm resistor -> LED anode, cathode -> GND) is not in the images. Its breadboard positions (columns 20-25, top half) are my choice. The built-in LED on pin 13 also works.
Which GND.n is which on the Uno is assumed: GND.1 is on the power header, GND.3 is the GND pin next to pin 13.
Breadboard hole positions are estimated from the image.
